--- FILE: .plaesy/spec/cafe/spec.md ---
# Spec: Cafe Financial Model

Status: draft
Topic: Cafe

## Purpose

This spec defines the financial requirements for a cafe business with a fixed monthly operating cost of 20 million rupiah and a drink product priced at 25 thousand rupiah per unit. It establishes the cost structure, pricing, and break-even metrics that the business must operate within.

## Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Acceptance criterion (Given / When / Then) | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | Monthly fixed costs are capped at 20 million rupiah | Given the cafe is in operation, when monthly expenses are tallied, then total fixed costs must not exceed IDR 20,000,000 | open |
| R2 | Standard drink pricing is set at 25 thousand rupiah per unit | Given a customer orders a drink, when the transaction is processed, then the price charged must be IDR 25,000 | open |
| R3 | Break-even point requires 800 drinks sold per month | Given fixed costs of IDR 20,000,000 and drink price of IDR 25,000, when monthly sales are calculated, then 800 drinks must be sold to cover fixed costs (20,000,000 ÷ 25,000 = 800) | open |
| R4 | Pricing covers variable costs and contributes to fixed cost recovery | Given each drink is priced at IDR 25,000, when cost of goods sold (COGS) is deducted, then the remaining margin must be sufficient to recover the fixed cost allocation | open |

## Non-goals

- This spec does not define variable costs per unit (COGS), staffing requirements, or inventory management
- This spec does not address marketing, customer acquisition, or demand forecasting
- This spec does not cover tax obligations, licensing, or legal requirements
- This spec does not define operating hours, capacity, or equipment specifications

## Open questions

- UNKNOWN: What are the variable costs (COGS) per drink? Owner: Business analyst.
- UNKNOWN: What is the expected daily/monthly customer volume? Owner: Sales/marketing team.
- ASSUMED — Drink category is uniform: all drinks are priced equally at IDR 25,000. Why: Simplifies pricing model pending menu differentiation requirements.
- ASSUMED — Fixed costs are rent, utilities, salaries, and overhead: does not include variable ingredients. Why: Standard cafe cost structure separation.

## References

(None provided in request)
